sentences.text: The fossils of Daniatrogon come from the Fur Formation, the type locality of the taxon.
These remains were recovered in Denmark.
The genus and its sole species were formally described as new to science by Gerald Mayr.
Mayr published the name Daniatrogon in 2026.
The taxonomic status of Daniatrogon is regarded as valid.
Daniatrogon lived in the Early Eocene epoch.
